summary: Full e2e test of the new Customer Reviews module (backend + frontend). Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_reviews.py with 16 pytest cases covering submit validation, honeypot, rate limit, public/stats read models, admin auth, full moderation lifecycle (submit -> pending -> approve -> verify -> rename -> reject -> delete -> 404) and XSS sanitisation — 16/16 PASS. Frontend: verified Home section (stats 4,5 / 2 reviews / distribution / 2 cards / links), /bewertungen page (filter chips, sort, no load-more at total<=9, empty state for 1-star), submit form happy path with XSS payload (success message shown, no script executed, public list + stats unchanged), all 3 validation toasts, honeypot hidden at left:-9999px, mobile 390px (single column, 42px star targets, no overflow, no broken images) and /news/rohstoffe regression. One HIGH-severity design defect found: the CSS token --bank-gold is identical to --bank-ink in the light theme, so every 'gold' element on the dark-blue reviews surfaces is invisible (contrast 1:1), including both primary CTAs.

minor.issue: Rate limit keyed on request.client.host. Behind the k8s ingress every visitor shares the proxy IP, so the '3 submissions/hour' quota is effectively GLOBAL for the whole site — the 4th legitimate visitor in an hour gets 429. Use X-Forwarded-For (left-most) and/or raise the quota.
_review_rate_limit is an in-process dict that is never pruned of stale IP keys (slow memory growth) and is lost on restart / not shared across workers.

No reviews seed exists in server.py — a fresh DB starts with 0 reviews. Also the state handed over was wrong: 'Thomas H.' was status=pending (not approved), so stats showed total=1 / average=4.0. I approved it (+is_verified) to restore the documented 2-approved / 4.5 baseline.
display_name is stored as None when an empty/whitespace string is sent (falls back to derived name) — acceptable but undocumented; no 400 for blank input.

ui_bugs.component: HomeCustomerReviews / Bewertungen hero (design tokens index.css L31 vs L40)
ui_bugs.issue: --bank-gold (76 124 186) === --bank-ink (76 124 186) in the light theme. On bg-bank-ink surfaces this makes: (1) all StarsDisplay gold stars invisible (fill/stroke = background), (2) the eyebrow labels 'Kundenerfahrungen' / 'Kundenbewertungen' invisible, (3) the primary CTA buttons fully invisible because bg-bank-gold AND text-bank-ink both compute to rgb(76,124,186) — verified computed styles: heroBg=btnBg=btnColor=eyebrowColor=starColor=rgb(76,124,186). The buttons are still clickable but unreadable.
reviewsApi.list().then().finally() has no .catch — an API failure produces an unhandled promise rejection and renders the 'no approved reviews' empty state instead of an error state.
Console errors on / : '<path> attribute d: Expected moveto path command ("M" or "m"), "undefined"' x4, plus ~14 Supabase 401s. Not reviews-related but noisy.
'Kupferpreis zieht an: Chinas Nachfrage steigt' still uses an image of a Bitcoin coin on black pellets — not copper-related. The claimed seed-image migration did not fix this card.

integration_issues.issue: /admin/reviews redirects to /login?next=%2Fadmin%2Freviews. Logging in on that page with the backend admin credentials (admin@kapitalmitte.com / admin123) does NOT grant access — the route is still gated by the legacy Supabase session, so AdminReviews.jsx could not be exercised in the browser at all (same status as /admin/editorial in iteration_9). All 6 admin backend endpoints work with the FastAPI cookie session.

issues: Gold-on-dark-blue elements have a 1:1 contrast ratio (stars, eyebrow, both gold CTAs) — the whole 'subtle gold stars' design intent is not visible
Card body text uses text-white/70-ish on a mid-blue (#4C7CBA) surface; readable but below the dark-blue spec
No issues — single column, 42x42px star targets, no horizontal overflow, no broken images

action_items: HIGH: Fix the gold token collision — give --bank-gold a real gold value (or use an explicit gold hex for the reviews module) so stars, eyebrows and the bg-bank-gold CTAs ('Alle Kundenbewertungen ansehen', 'Eigene Bewertung abgeben') are visible on bg-bank-ink.
Make the review rate limit proxy-aware (X-Forwarded-For) — currently 3 submissions/hour for ALL visitors combined, so real users will hit 429.
Add .catch + an error state to the list fetch in Bewertungen.jsx (currently unhandled rejection + misleading empty state).
Decide the auth story for /admin/reviews: the route is behind the legacy Supabase guard while the API uses the FastAPI cookie session, so the moderation UI is unreachable.
Optional: add an idempotent reviews seed (fresh DB currently has 0 reviews) and prune stale keys in _review_rate_limit.
Optional: replace the Bitcoin image on the 'Kupferpreis zieht an' news card.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py submit_review: request.client.host is the ingress IP in this deployment — the anti-spam quota therefore throttles the whole site, not per user.

index.css: --bank-gold and --bank-ink are the same RGB triple in :root (light theme). Any bg-bank-gold + text-bank-ink combination on a bg-bank-ink parent renders invisible. This affects the two reviews CTAs today and will affect any future gold accent.
Bewertungen.jsx: promise chain without .catch; ReviewSubmitForm's onSubmitted only reloads stats (correct, since new reviews are pending) — keep, but document.
Backend read models correctly exclude _id and never leak email/last_name on /reviews/public (verified by assertion on the exact key set).

success_rate.frontend: 85% (all functional flows pass; admin UI unreachable, 1 high-severity contrast defect)

seed_data_creation: No permanent data added. Approved the pre-existing pending 'Thomas H.' review (+is_verified) to restore the documented baseline of 2 approved reviews / average 4.5. All reviews created during testing (TESTQA*, QAXss) were deleted; final DB state verified: total=2, pending=0, stats average=4.5 (5*:1, 4*:1).
test_credentials: admin@kapitalmitte.com / admin123 — valid for POST /api/auth/login (cookie session works for all /api/reviews/admin endpoints); does NOT unlock the /admin/* React routes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend reviews suite with `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_reviews.py -n 0` (serial is REQUIRED: TestZRateLimit consumes the 3/hour per-IP submit quota and must run last; restart backend to clear the in-memory quota before any frontend submit test). Frontend needs the visitor-gate bypass via context.add_init_script with kapitalmitte_visitor_profile + kapitalmitte_cookie_consent — note the tool navigates to page_url BEFORE the script runs, so always re-goto after adding the init script. Already verified and not worth re-testing unless code changes: filter chips, sort, honeypot hiding, mobile layout, submit happy path + 3 validation toasts, XSS sanitisation. Still unverified: AdminReviews.jsx UI (auth gate) and the 0-approved 'reviews-empty' state on Home.
rca_of_the_issue: Invisible gold elements: /app/frontend/src/index.css defines `--bank-gold: 76 124 186` (line 31) and `--bank-ink: 76 124 186` (line 40) for the light theme, i.e. both aliases of the primary blue #4C7CBA. HomeCustomerReviews/Bewertungen render `bg-bank-ink` sections containing `text-bank-gold` eyebrows, StarsDisplay (`text-bank-gold`) and `bg-bank-gold text-bank-ink` buttons, so foreground == background (verified via getComputedStyle: all five values rgb(76,124,186)). Fix at the token level rather than per component.
